summary: Defines what the solver optimizes (cost basis + custom min/min-max terms + early-arrival behavior).
businessRules: objective defines: This attribute is used to configure the objective of the optimization job.
Must stay consistent with: options.objective.travel_cost, options.objective.custom. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Vehicle's allowed_zones must include the job/shipment's zones.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Interaction: Positive: all jobs feasible under hard constraints + balancing options enabled -> all jobs still assigned (assert assignment count only, never the specific route distribution).
Interaction: Negative-infeasible: a job infeasible under a hard constraint (e.g. impossible time window) stays unassigned regardless of balancing weights (assert unassigned reason).
